properties.label: applies to jurisdiction
properties.description: the item (institution, law, public office, public register, etc) or statement belongs to or has power over or applies to the value (a territorial jurisdiction: a country, state, municipality, etc)

properties.label: member of political party
properties.description: the political party of which a person is or has been a member or otherwise affiliated

properties.label: product or material produced
properties.description: material or product, including services, produced or provided by an organization, industry, facility, or process

properties.label: employer
properties.description: person or organization for which the subject works or worked

properties.label: founder
properties.description: founder or co-founder of this organization, religion, place or entity

properties.label: league or competition
properties.description: league or competition in which team or player has played, or in which an event occurs

properties.label: unemployment rate
properties.description: portion of a workforce population that is not employed

properties.label: publisher
properties.description: organization or person responsible for publishing a work, such as a book, periodical, printed music, podcast, game or software

properties.label: owned by
properties.description: owner of the subject

properties.label: located in the administrative territorial entity
properties.description: the item is located on the territory of the following administrative entity. Use P276 for specifying locations that are non-administrative places and for items about events. Use P1382 if the item falls only partially into the administrative entity

properties.label: territory claimed by
properties.description: administrative divisions that claim control of a given area

properties.label: participant in
properties.description: event in which a person, organization or creative work was/is a participant; inverse of P710 or P1923

properties.label: genre
properties.description: creative work's genre or an artist's field of work (P101). Use main subject (P921) to relate creative works to their topic

properties.label: replaces
properties.description: person, state or item replaced. Use "structure replaces" (P1398) for structures. Use "follows" (P155) if the previous item was not replaced or predecessor and successor are identical

properties.label: replaced by
properties.description: other person or item which continues the item by replacing it in its role. Use P156 ("followed by") if the item is not replaced nor identical, but adds to the series (e.g. books in a series)

properties.label: operator
properties.description: person, profession, organization or entity that operates the equipment, facility, or service

properties.label: capital of
properties.description: country, state, department, canton or other administrative division of which the municipality is the governmental seat

properties.label: religion or worldview
properties.description: religion of a person, organization or religious building, or associated with this subject

properties.label: languages spoken, written or signed
properties.description: language(s) that a person or a people speaks, writes or signs, including the native language(s)

properties.label: present in work
properties.description: this (fictional or fictionalized) entity, place, or person appears in that work as part of the narration (use P2860 for works citing other works, P361/P1433 for works being part of other works, P1343 for entities described in non-fictional accounts)

properties.label: contains the administrative territorial entity
properties.description: (list of) direct subdivisions of an administrative territorial entity

properties.label: follows
properties.description: immediately prior item in a series of which the subject is a part, preferably use as qualifier of P179 [if the subject has replaced the preceding item, e.g. political offices, use "replaces" (P1365)]

properties.label: followed by
properties.description: immediately following item in a series of which the subject is a part, preferably use as qualifier of P179 [if the subject has been replaced, e.g. political offices, use "replaced by" (P1366)]

properties.label: headquarters location
properties.description: city or town where an organization's headquarters is or has been situated. Use P276 qualifier for specific building

properties.label: cast member
properties.description: actor in the subject production [use "character role" (P453) and/or "name of the character role" (P4633) as qualifiers] [use "voice actor" (P725) for voice-only role] - [use "recorded participant" (P11108) for non-fiction productions]

properties.label: producer
properties.description: person(s) who produced the film, musical work, theatrical production, etc. (for film, this does not include executive producers, associate producers, etc.) [for production company, use P272, video games - use P178]

properties.label: award received
properties.description: award or recognition received by a person, organization or creative work

properties.label: country
properties.description: sovereign state that this subject item is in (not to be used for human beings)

properties.label: creator
properties.description: maker of this creative work or other object (where no more specific property exists)

properties.label: parent taxon
properties.description: closest parent taxon of the taxon in question

properties.label: ethnic group
properties.description: subject's ethnicity (consensus is that a VERY high standard of proof is needed for this field to be used. In general this means 1) the subject claims it themselves, or 2) it is widely agreed on by scholars, or 3) is fictional and portrayed as such)

properties.label: performer
properties.description: actor, musician, band or other performer associated with this role or musical work

properties.label: manufacturer
properties.description: (main or final) manufacturer or producer of this product

properties.label: developer
properties.description: organization or person that developed the item

properties.label: part of the series
properties.description: series which contains the subject

properties.label: place of birth
properties.description: most specific known birth location of a person, animal or fictional character

properties.label: legislative body
properties.description: legislative body governing this entity; political institution with elected representatives, such as a parliament/legislature or council

properties.label: place of death
properties.description: most specific known (e.g. city instead of country, or hospital instead of city) death location of a person, animal or fictional character

properties.label: basin country
properties.description: country that have drainage to/from or border the body of water

properties.label: located in or next to body of water
properties.description: body of water on or next to which a place is located

properties.label: father
properties.description: male parent of the subject. For stepfather, use "stepparent" (P3448)

properties.label: military branch
properties.description: branch to which this military unit, award, office, or person belongs, e.g. Royal Navy

properties.label: mother
properties.description: female parent of the subject. For stepmother, use "stepparent" (P3448)

properties.label: spouse
properties.description: the subject has the object as their spouse (husband, wife, partner, etc.). Use "unmarried partner" (P451) for non-married companions

properties.label: record label
properties.description: brand and trademark associated with the marketing of subject music recordings and music videos

properties.label: country of citizenship
properties.description: the object is a country that recognizes the subject as its citizen

properties.label: production company
properties.description: company that produced this film, audio or performing arts work

properties.label: location
properties.description: location of the object, structure or event; use P131 to indicate the containing administrative entity, P8138 for statistical entities, or P706 for geographic entities; use P7153 for locations associated with the object

properties.label: subclass of
properties.description: this item is a subclass (subset) of that item; ALL instances of this item are instances of that item; different from P31 (instance of), e.g.: volcano is a subclass of mountain; Everest is an instance of mountain

properties.label: continent
properties.description: continent of which the subject is a part

properties.label: instance of
properties.description: type to which this subject corresponds/belongs. Different from P279 (subclass of); for example: K2 is an instance of mountain; volcano is a subclass of mountain

properties.label: sibling
properties.description: the subject and the object have at least one common parent (brother, sister, etc. including half-siblings); use "relative" (P1038) for siblings-in-law (brother-in-law, sister-in-law, etc.) and step-siblings (step-brothers, step-sisters, etc.)

properties.label: head of state
properties.description: official with the highest formal authority in a country/state

properties.label: child organization or unit
properties.description: child organization/unit of an org./unit; usually a fully owned separate org.; for non-independent sub-units, see org. division (P199); opposite of parent org./unit (P749); use instance of (P31) to distinguish org. (Q43229) and org. unit (Q10387680)

properties.label: capital
properties.description: seat of government of a country, province, state or other type of administrative territorial entity

properties.label: part of
properties.description: object of which the subject is a part (if this subject is already part of object A which is a part of object B, then please only make the subject part of object A), inverse property of "has part" (P527, see also "has parts of the class" (P2670))

properties.label: original language of film or TV show
properties.description: language in which a film or a performance work was originally created. Deprecated for written works and songs; use P407 ("language of work or name") instead.

properties.label: official language
properties.description: language designated as official by this item

properties.label: position held
properties.description: subject currently or formerly holds the object position or public office

properties.label: child
properties.description: subject has object as child. Do not use for stepchildren—use "relative" (P1038), qualified with "kinship to subject" (P1039)

properties.label: platform
properties.description: platform for which a work was developed or released, or the specific platform version of a software product

properties.label: mouth of the watercourse
properties.description: the body of water to which the watercourse drains

properties.label: original broadcaster
properties.description: network(s) or service(s) that originally broadcast a radio or television program

properties.label: member of
properties.description: organization, club or musical group to which the subject belongs. Do not use for membership in ethnic or social groups, nor for holding a political position, such as a member of parliament (use P39 for that)

properties.label: chairman
properties.description: presiding member of an organization, group or body

properties.label: country of origin
properties.description: country of origin of this item (creative work, food, phrase, product, etc.)

properties.label: author
properties.description: main creator(s) of a written work (use on works, not humans); use P2093 (author name string) when Wikidata item is unknown or does not exist

properties.label: has part(s)
properties.description: part of this subject; inverse property of "part of" (P361). See also "has parts of the class" (P2670).

properties.label: member of sports team
properties.description: sports teams or clubs that the subject represents or represented

properties.label: residence
properties.description: the place where the person is or has been, resident

properties.label: date of birth
properties.description: date on which the subject was born

properties.label: director
properties.description: director(s) of film, TV-series, stageplay, video game or similar

properties.label: date of death
properties.description: date on which the subject died

properties.label: inception
properties.description: time when an entity begins to exist; for date of official opening use P1619

properties.label: dissolved, abolished or demolished
properties.description: point in time at which the subject (organisation, building) ceased to exist; see "date of official closure" (P3999) for closing a facility, "service retirement" (P730) for retiring equipment, "discontinued date" (P2669) for stopping a product

properties.label: publication date
properties.description: date or point in time when a work or product was first published or released

properties.label: screenwriter
properties.description: person(s) who wrote the script for subject item

properties.label: start time
properties.description: time an entity begins to exist or a statement starts being valid

properties.label: end time
properties.description: moment when an entity ceases to exist and a statement stops being entirely valid or no longer be true

properties.label: point in time
properties.description: date something took place, existed or a statement was true; for providing time use the "refine date" property (P4241)

properties.label: head of government
properties.description: head of the executive power of this town, city, municipality, state, country, or other governmental body

properties.label: participated in conflict
properties.description: battles, wars or other military engagements in which the person or item participated

properties.label: characters
properties.description: characters which appear in this item (like plays, operas, operettas, books, comics, films, TV series, video games)

properties.label: lyricist
properties.description: author of song lyrics

properties.label: educated at
properties.description: educational institution attended by subject

properties.label: located in/on physical feature
properties.description: located on the specified (geo)physical feature. Should not be used when the value is only political/administrative (P131) or a mountain range (P4552). Use P206 for things in/on bodies of water.

properties.label: participant
properties.description: person, group of people or organization (object) that actively takes/took part in an event or process (subject). Preferably qualify with "object has role" (P3831). Use P1923 for participants that are teams.

properties.label: influenced by
properties.description: the subject (person, idea, etc.) was influenced or inspired by this object entity, e.g. "Heidegger was influenced by Aristotle"

properties.label: location of formation
properties.description: location where a group or organization was formed

properties.label: parent organization or unit
properties.description: parent organization or unit of an organization or unit, opposite of child organization or unit (P355); use instance of (P31) to distinguish organization (Q43229) and organization unit (Q10387680)

properties.label: notable work
properties.description: notable scientific, artistic or literary work, or other work of significance among subject's works

properties.label: separated from
properties.description: subject was founded or started by separating from identified object

properties.label: narrative location
properties.description: the narrative of the work is set in this location

properties.label: composer
properties.description: person(s) who wrote the music [for lyricist, use "lyrics by" (P676)]

properties.label: work location
properties.description: location where persons or organisations were actively participating in employment, business or other work
